judged_text: embeddable_host is stored as free text with no validation or normalization while every code path compares it to the exact downcased URI host. An admin who enters 'http://myblog.com', 'myblog.com/', or a capitalized host makes every embed request fail the referer check with a 403 and no diagnostic anywhere — all embeds silently never work and nothing in the UI or logs explains why.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` (config/site_settings.yml) and enforces exact string equality against `URI(...).host` in both `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` (`URI(request.referer||'').host != SiteSetting.embeddable_host`) and `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` (`SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host`). There is no normalization/validation of the setting value in this diff, so admin inputs like including a scheme (`http://...`) or a trailing slash would not match `.host` and would break embedding. However, the finding overstates details: the code does not "downcase" the URI host anywhere, and failures are not totally silent because `ensure_embeddable` raises `Discourse::InvalidAccess` with messages like 'invalid referer host'. This is still a concrete, diff-grounded robustness/config UX issue but not an inherent logic/security defect for correctly-configured values.
